U_0x00D061: A space-faring vessel used by the <Earth Fed Army> and others. Its frame-type hull can be fitted with multi-purpose weapon units armed with missiles and laser weapons, containers housing launch catapults for <Armored Module>s or <Personal Trooper>s, and cargo containers for supply transport. This lets it serve as a battleship, mothership, transport, or multi-role support vessel.
U_0x00D259: A large space battleship used by the <Earth Fed Army> and others. Equipped with command functions, it is often deployed as a fleet flagship, and boasts excellent search capability and spacecraft control functions. It is composed of a battle carrier that carries space fighters and <Armored Module>s, along with five beam-cannon ships. The beam-cannon ships can also act independently, and can evacuate their crew to be used as missiles themselves.
U_0x00D478: An all-purpose battle carrier used by <Shadow Mirror>. Equipped with a <Tesla Drive>, this large vessel excels in both carrying capacity and stealth, and can operate in space, air, and underwater. It is said to have been built to counter Spacenoah-class all-purpose battle carriers such as Hagane, though this is not confirmed.
U_0x00D634: The second Spacenoah-class all-purpose battle carrier, built for combat against extraterrestrials. It floats via its <Tesla Drive> and is propelled by eight main rocket engines. Its hull is made of a super-drag-resistant metal, allowing not only space travel but also atmospheric flight and underwater diving. It also boasts excellent anti-ship bombardment capability and can carry <Personal Trooper>s and various fighter craft, realizing the Federation tactic known as "ISA" (Integrated Synchronizing Attack: a lightning assault combining a mobile battleship acting as a carrier with the humanoid mobile weapons it carries).\nThe Spacenoah class was conceived from two opposing aims - "escort ship for the Earth-evacuation fleet" and "battle carrier for <PT>s in the war against extraterrestrials" - and, working against the grain of the larger Earth Evacuation Plan, it ended up granted the combat capability envisioned under the Earth Sphere Defense Concept. To conceal this dual purpose, the ship adopted an unprecedented flexible structure for a battleship: by modularizing the vessel, the hull and main engines form a common core, allowing purpose-built combat modules to be swapped in relatively short order. The part subject to replacement is the bow section, and the first, second, and third ships each carry a different module.\nThe second ship, Hagane, mounts a high-output heavy-metal particle cannon, the Tronium Buster Cannon, as its bow module, giving it top-class firepower among Federation warships. Its codename is "Steel 2."
U_0x00DDA4: The third Spacenoah-class all-purpose battle carrier, built for combat against extraterrestrials. It floats via its <Tesla Drive> and is propelled by eight main rocket engines. Kurogane's bow module is an oversized rotating ram for shattering bedrock (the Anti-Ship/Anti-Bedrock Excalibur Drill Ram), enabling anti-ship melee combat and the clearing of obstacles such as rock or ice in its path. When the <Tesla Drive>'s output is raised above a certain threshold, it forms the "Break Field," a T-dot array force field covering the whole ship; used together with the oversized rotating ram, this allows it to break through wide-area <Energy Field>s such as those found around enemy fortresses. Its codename is "Iron 3."
U_0x00E122: A general-purpose battle carrier converted from humanity's first deep-space exploration vessel, the Hiryuu. It was also the first ship fitted with a <Tesla Drive>. In New Era 179, it was attacked by a fleet of <Aerogater> mobile weapons in the space beyond Pluto's orbit and suffered moderate damage; after paying a heavy price, it returned to Icarus Base in the asteroid belt. It later underwent a major refit based on the "ISA" (Integrated Synchronizing Attack: a lightning assault combining a mobile battleship acting as a carrier with the humanoid mobile weapons it carries) tactical doctrine, being reborn as the general-purpose battle carrier "Hiryuu Kai." Its bow is fitted with a super-gravity impact cannon derived from <EOT> technology, giving it combat capability second only to Hagane and Kurogane. Its codename is "Dragon 2."
